seoTitle: How to Create an Image Slider in Shopify Dawn Theme
metaDescription: Add and customize an image slider or carousel in the Shopify Dawn theme without coding to make your store more engaging.
intro: A well-placed image slider can make your homepage feel more polished and highlight your best products or promotions. This guide covers how to add and customize an image slider in the Shopify Dawn theme using the built-in customizer, no coding required.

steps.heading: Open the Shopify theme customizer
steps.body: Go to Online Store in your Shopify admin and open the customizer for your Dawn theme.

steps.heading: Add an image slider section
steps.body: Insert a slideshow or carousel section onto your homepage using the customizer's section options.

steps.heading: Upload and arrange images
steps.body: Upload the banner or product images you want in the slider and arrange them in your preferred order.

steps.heading: Adjust slider settings
steps.body: Fine-tune settings like autoplay speed, transition style, and text overlays to match your store's look.

steps.heading: Preview and save
steps.body: Preview the slider on desktop and mobile to confirm it looks right before publishing the changes.

faq.question: Do I need to edit code to add a slider in Dawn theme?
faq.answer: No, the Dawn theme includes a built-in slideshow section you can add and customize entirely through the theme customizer.

faq.question: How many images can I add to the slider?
faq.answer: The Dawn theme's slideshow section supports multiple slides, so you can add several images and reorder them as needed.

faq.question: Can I link each slide to a different page?
faq.answer: Yes, each slide typically supports its own button or link, so you can direct customers to specific products or collections.

faq.question: Will the slider work well on mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes, the Dawn theme's slider is responsive by default, adjusting its layout automatically for mobile screens.
